{{Short description|Russian chemist (born 1946)}}
'''Georgiy Borisovich Shul’pin''' ({{langx|ru|Георгий Борисович Шульпи́н}}, also '''Shulpin''', 22 July 1946 – 3 March 2023) was born in [[Moscow]], [[Russia]]. He graduated with a M.S. degree in chemistry from the Chemistry Department of [[Moscow State University]] in 1969. Between 1969 and 1972, he was a postgraduate student at the [[Nesmeyanov Institute of Organoelement Compounds]] (Academy of Sciences of the USSR, Moscow) under the direction of Prof. A. N. [[Nesmeyanov]] and received his Ph.D. in [[organometallic chemistry]] in 1975.<ref name='MAOC66'>{{cite book | last1 = Smith | first1 = M.B. | last2 = March | first2 = J. | title = March's Advanced Organic Chemistry: Reactions, Mechanisms, and Structure | publisher = J. Wiley & Sons, Inc. | year = 2007 | location = New Jersey | pages = 66 | url = http://www.wiley.com/WileyCDA/WileyTitle/productCd-0471720917.html | accessdate = 2010-11-30 | isbn = 978-0-471-72091-1}}</ref> He received his Dr. of Sciences degree in 2013.

==Career==
Since 1978, Shul’pin has been working at the N. N. [[Semenov Institute of Chemical Physics]] at the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] in Moscow. He is currently a senior scientific researcher. His research activities concern metal complex catalysis,<ref>B. Plietker (Ed.), “Iron Catalysis in Organic Chemistry: Reactions and Applications”, WILEY-VCH, Weinheim, 2008, pp. 77, 80. {{ISBN|978-3-527-31927-5}}</ref> oxidation of hydrocarbons<ref name="Carruthers Carruthers Coldham 2004 p. In eighties Shul’pin together with [[A.E. Shilov]] discovered the [[metalation reaction]] of [[arenes]] by [[hexachloroplatinate]] which is stimulated by heating, light or gamma-irradiation<ref>R. H. Crabtree, “The organometallic chemistry of alkanes”, Chem. Rev. 1985, 85, 245-269. {{doi|10.1021/cr00068a002}}</ref><ref>V. K. Jain, G. S. Rao, L. Jain, “The Organic Chemistry of Platinum(IV)”, in: “Advances in Organometallic Chemistry”, vol. 27, Academic Press, Inc., 1987, p. 116. {{ISBN|0-12-031127-5}}</ref><ref>G. K. Anderson, “Platinum-Carbon sigma-Bonded Complexes”, in: R. J. Puddephatt (Ed.), “Comprehensive Organometallic Chemistry II”, Elsevier, 1995, p. 518. {{ISBN|0-08-042316-7}}</ref><ref>L. Johansson, O. Matsumoto, “Synthesis of aryl-platinum dinuclear complexes via ortho C-H bond activation of phenol and transmetalation of arylboronic acid”, Organometallics, 2005, 24, 5528-5536. {{doi|10.1021/om050316l}}</ref>

He developed aerobic oxygenation of saturated [[hydrocarbons]] under visible light irradiation catalyzed by [[oxo synthesis|oxo]] and [[chloride]] complexes of [[transition metals]]<ref>J.-E. Bäckvall (Ed.), “Modern Oxidation Methods”, WILEY-VCH Verlag, Weinheim, 2004, p. 121. {{ISBN|3-527-30642-0}} http://www.wiley-vch.de/publish/en/books/bySubjectCH00/ISBN3-527-30642-0/?sID=8245b6d09961810d71a72151875fb5a1</ref> and discovered three efficient systems for the catalytic oxidations with hydrogen peroxide. Catalytic combinations: i) “vanadium derivative plus pyrazine-2-carboxylic acid (PCA)”;<ref>P. P. Knops-Gerrits, C. A. Trujillo, B. Z. Zhan, X. Y. Li, P. Rouxhet, P. A. Jacobs, “Oxidation catalysis with well-characterised vanadyl bis-bipyridine complexes encapsulated in NaY zeolite”, Topics in Catalysis, 1996, 437-449. {{doi|10.1007/BF02113866}}</ref><ref>W. A. G. B. Shul’pin proposed a simple and convenient method for the estimation of concentration of alkyl hydroperoxides formed in [[alkane]] [[oxidations]] by [[molecular]] oxygen or peroxides. This method (gas-chromatographic analysis of the samples before and after their reduction by [[triphenylphosphine]], “Shul’pin’s method”) is widely used in chemical practice.<ref>Q. Yuan, W. Deng, Q. Zhang, Y. Wang, “Osmium-catalyzed selective oxidations of methane and ethane with hydrogen peroxide in aqueous medium”, Adv. Synth. Catal. 2007, 349, 1199–1209. {{doi|10.1002/adsc.200600438}}</ref><ref>L. Zhou, Y. Chen, X. Yang, Y. Su, W. Zhang, J. Xu, “Electronic effect of substituent of quinones on their catalytic performance in hydrocarbons oxidation”, Catal. Let. 2008, 125, 154-159. {{doi|10.1007/s10562-008-9537-y}}</ref><ref>G. S. Mishra, T. F. S. Silva, L. M. D. R. S. Martins, A. J. L. Pombeiro,”Scorpionate complexes of vanadium(III or IV) as catalyst precursors for solvent-free cyclohexane oxidation with dioxygen”, Pure Appl. Chem., 2009, 81, 1217–1227. {{doi|10.1351/PAC-CON-08-10-08}}</ref><ref>K. T. Mahmudov, M. N. Kopylovich, M. F. C. G. da Silva, P. J. Figiel, Y. Y. Karabach, A. J. L. Pombeiro, “New copper(II) dimer and its catalytic activity in cyclohexane and benzyl alcohol oxidations”, J. Mol. Catal., A: Chem. 2010, 318, 44-50. {{doi|10.1016/j.molcata.2009.11.006}}</ref><ref>P. Roy, M. Manassero, “Tetranuclear copper(II)–Schiff-base complexes as active catalysts for oxidation of cyclohexane and toluene”, Dalton Trans. 2010, 1539-1545. {{doi|10.1039/b914017d}}</ref><ref>S. Bose, A. Pariyar, A. N. Biswas, P. Das, P. Bandyopadhyay, “Mild oxidation of hydrocarbons by tert-butyl hydroperoxide catalyzed by electron deficient manganese(III) corroles”, J. Mol. Catal., A: Chem. 2010, 332, 1-6 {{doi|10.1016/j.molcata.2010.09.001}}.</ref>

G. B. Shul’pin has published about 250 papers in chemical journals. He is the author (coauthor) of monographs<ref>S. P. Gubin, G. B. Shul’pin, “The Chemistry of Complexes with Metal-Carbon Bonds”, Novosibirsk, Nauka, 1984, 280 pp. (in Russian).</ref><ref>G. B. Shul’pin, “Organic Reactions Catalyzed by Metal Complexes”, Nauka, Moscow, 1988 (285 pp., in Russian). {{ISBN|5-02-001351-X}}</ref><ref>A. E. Shilov, G. B.
